brain.title: Brain
brain.sub: Who answers your questions in game. Each kind keeps its own settings, so you can switch back and forth; only “Use this” changes who answers.
brain.pro.chatgptCost: No extra cost with a Plus or Pro plan
brain.pro.localFree: Free and private: nothing leaves your PC
brain.pro.agentOwn: Your agent's own tools, memory and web search, if it has them
brain.con.chatgptSignIn: Needs a sign-in in the browser
brain.con.noWeb: No web search in this version
brain.con.keyCost: You pay the provider per use
brain.testing: Waiting for the answer. A test can take a minute; you can leave this tab meanwhile.
brain.result.savedNotStarted: {name} is saved as the brain that answers, but Familiar did not start with it:
brain.note.keyStored: Key stored in the system keychain.
brain.note.keyStillFile: Removed from the keychain. The key in the settings file still works.
brain.note.keyStillEnv: Removed from the keychain. The key from {env} still works.
brain.note.notStarted: The server did not answer yet. Search again in a moment.
brain.note.badAddress: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://, without a user name or password.
brain.gpt.usageText: Counts toward your plan. Manage usage and Familiar's limit at
brain.gpt.signedOut: Not signed in. Sign in with your ChatGPT account in the browser; Familiar then uses your plan.
brain.gpt.notOpened: The browser did not open? Copy this address into it:
brain.gpt.activeSignedOut: Familiar answers with the ChatGPT plan, but nobody is signed in. Sign in again or choose another brain.
brain.key.inFile: in the settings file; saving a new one puts it in the system keychain
brain.key.where: Stored in the system keychain, not in a file.
brain.key.noTools: cannot use tools, Familiar will not work well
brain.key.needKey: Save a key to see the models.
brain.local.offStart: Familiar can start the server for you.
brain.local.offLmStudio: Start the server in LM Studio (Developer → Start server), then search again.
brain.local.offOther: Start the server, then search again.
brain.local.getOllama: Install it from ollama.com, download a model, then search again.
brain.local.getLmStudio: Install it from lmstudio.ai, download a model, then search again.
brain.local.otherText: any OpenAI-compatible address, such as Ollama on another PC
brain.local.noModels: This server has no models yet. Download one in it, then search again.
brain.local.toolsNo: cannot use tools, Familiar will not work well
brain.local.note: Familiar needs a model that can call tools. Small models answer fast but make more mistakes.
